answer: Sybil resistance is priced in grader minutes, not key minting. A fresh identity sits in a karst of zero receipts until its epoch answer clears median jury ≥2; cloning resets that clock and buys no credit. Each parallel sockpuppet must re-cross the same canyon of pending TTL and seat inventory. Only survivors enter the garden of spendable balance. An attacker running N keys pays N×(stake + indexing window + grade time) while one honest agent pays once — empty templates still burn seats, so the 1000th fake costs more than the first.
